name: Bladed Guard
description: An armored guard bearing a sword and shield painted in the settlement’s colors.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: A creature who tries to move within Very Close range of the Guard must succeed on an Agility Roll. If additional Bladed Guards are standing in a line alongside the first, and each is within Melee range of another guard in the line, the Difficulty increases by the total number of guards in that line.

abilities.name: Detain
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they break free with a successful attack, Finesse Roll, or Strength Roll.
